title: A Min of 0 on a floating-point simulation is honoured, not replaced by the smallest denormal
intent: Guards the minValueForType fix. It used to return Double.MIN_VALUE, which is the smallest POSITIVE denormal (4.9E-324), not the most negative double. Callers use it as a lower clamp via maxOf(), so any configured Min <= 0 was silently discarded and a "Min": 0 square wave oscillated between 4.9E-324 and Max instead of between 0 and Max. Note the assertion is set MEMBERSHIP, not a numeric range: 4.9E-324 lies inside [0, 100], so a range check would have passed the bug. Float is included because it had the same defect via Float.MIN_VALUE.

assert.comment: Membership, not range. Square is a function of wall clock, so a short window may legitimately observe only one of the two levels - which is why this is not channelValueSet.
